message: JSON.parse of built-in tool arguments has no try/catch — malformed JSON from the model throws an uncaught exception, aborting the agentic loop.
JSON.parse of built-in tool arguments in the streaming handler has no try/catch — malformed JSON throws and terminates the stream without a clean error response.
handleStreaming (async) is returned without await, so the Vercel handler resolves before streaming completes and can close the connection prematurely.
emptyRetries records the next available model (not the one that just failed), so the skip list can blacklist the wrong model and never skip the actual culprit.
nextOpenRouterKey returns an empty string when OPENROUTER_API_KEYS is empty, causing all OpenRouter-routed models to be called with a blank Bearer token instead of failing fast.
